name: PRIMS-F limit-cycle settling and discretization-convergence criteria v2

window.markers: pressure peaks of p_riser_base_Pa from analyze_osc_envelopes.pressure_envelope; the last eleven enclosed peaks
window.requirement: eleven distinct strictly increasing markers delimit exactly ten complete cycles; fewer markers => not settled, never padded
window.phase: each cycle mapped linearly to phi in [0,1) with 256 samples; the period is reported separately

channels.junction_note: base = junction face (single flux per phase shared by both cells); out = separator face

per_cycle_quantities.m_k: time mean over cycle k (trapezoid of the piecewise-linear monitor including interpolated end points)
per_cycle_quantities.r_k: range max-min of the 256-sample phase waveform of cycle k

absolute_floors.rationale: near-zero channels are normalized by dimensioned absolute tolerances, never by a near-zero mean
absolute_floors.mass_flux: 1e-4 * feed mass flow of the same phase, from the accepted inlet flux integral over the window
absolute_floors.inventory: 1e-4 * feed mass flow of the same phase * mean period (mass processed per cycle)

C0_pressure_preserved.rule: (max-min)/|mean| <= 0.005 for period, semi-amplitude and cycle-mean pressure of p_riser_base_Pa

C1_cycle_mean_drift.rule: max(max_k m_k - min_k m_k, 9*|OLS slope of m_k versus k|) <= 0.05 * max(Rbar, floor), every channel
C1_cycle_mean_drift.justification: secular drift must be a small fraction of the oscillation the cycle is supposed to repeat. For pressure 0.05*Rbar ~ 0.05*2*1e4 Pa is the same order as the preserved 0.005*2.66e5 Pa; for inventories the mean (~70 kg) is not a meaningful scale for drift

C2_cycle_range_variation.rule: (max_k r_k - min_k r_k) <= 0.01 * max(Rbar, floor), every channel
C2_cycle_range_variation.justification: twice the preserved 0.5% amplitude limit because non-pressure extrema are sampled, not parabolically refined

C3_waveform_shape.rule: max_k RMS_phi(y_k - ybar) <= 0.02 * max(Rbar, floor), every channel
C3_waveform_shape.justification: within-cycle phase jitter allowed by C0 (period variation <=0.5%) gives RMS <~0.006 Rbar for a sinusoid; 0.02 keeps a factor ~3 and detects cycle-to-cycle shape changes

settling.settled: C0 and C1 and C2 and C3 for all channels; any missing channel => not settled

convergence_between_settled_runs.preserved_targets: relative difference of period and pressure semi-amplitude <= 0.01

added.mean_level: |Mbar_f - Mbar_c| <= 0.01 * max(|Mbar|, Rbar, floor), every channel
added.shape_phase_fixed: RMS_phi(ybar_f - ybar_c) <= 0.02 * max(Rbar, floor), every channel; phase is NOT re-aligned
added.phase_diagnostic: best circular lag maximizing correlation is reported as phase error; it never replaces the phase-fixed error

not_implied: mass conservation does not imply inventory convergence
settling does not imply discretization convergence
